“Master,” the six-armed silhouette stood respectfully, bowing to Lin Yuan.

As the ‘Spirit’ of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, it could sense every change within the secret realm; naturally, it was aware of Lin Yuan’s entrance.

“Hmm.”

“You may leave now.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the six-armed silhouette and gave the order.

...

“Yes.”

The six-armed silhouette respectfully withdrew.

“Now it’s safe.”

Lin Yuan’s mind relaxed. Despite being on the Milky Way Main Star, he was not entirely safe, carrying many extraordinary items. However, in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, there was no danger at all.

“Let’s take a look at this silver mirror.”

Lin Yuan directly took out the silver mirror.

Buzz.

Freed from the constraints of the two-dimensional world, the silver mirror seemed to awaken, emitting vast spatial fluctuations, like a small universe being opened up.

As the lord of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, though, Lin Yuan, who could mobilize the entire realm’s power, didn’t feel any pressure.

“After bringing it out, do I need to refine it to reopen the space it contains?”

Lin Yuan appeared contemplative. In the main universe, the might of the silver mirror, an ultimate weapon, was reviving. Refining it was necessary to utilize it even at a basic level.

Of course, refining the silver mirror wasn’t difficult for Lin Yuan.

Back in the two-dimensional world, Lin Yuan had already poured a massive amount of mental energy into it, tantamount to half-refining it.

Continuing to refine it now was merely the natural course of things, a task he could complete in one or two months at most.

Of course, it was just the refining part. To fully unleash this ultimate weapon and bring its power back to life, Lin Yuan at his current level couldn’t manage—only after reaching Tier 11 and undergoing a vast and transformative enhancement of his strength would it be possible.

In human civilization’s history, occasionally, powerful Evolvers wielding ultimate weapons would venture into medium and small-sized otherworldly battlefields, creating permanent spatial rifts.

In fact, it was Supreme Beings behind the scenes driving the ultimate weapons, not ordinary Eleventh-Rank Evolvers. Even if they exhausted all their strength, they couldn’t deal a Twelfth Rank Level blow with an ultimate weapon.

…

During the period of refining the silver mirror.

Lin Yuan took out five radiant orbs of light.

These were Lin Yuan’s rewards as the victor. As for those extraordinary items, they were things Lin Yuan had painstakingly searched for in the two-dimensional world and didn’t count as rewards.

Among the five radiant orbs, one had a pure aura, precisely representing the spatiotemporal understanding of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

As for the other four orbs, they seemed slightly ‘turbid.’

“Let’s check this orb.”

Lin Yuan randomly selected one of the four orbs and cautiously probed into it with his mind.

In an instant.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness began to roar.

“This?” Lin Yuan was astounded.

He had become a mammoth Flame Giant, incredibly lofty, millions of kilometers tall, currently lying asleep in an immense sea of magma.

“Is this the Turbid Fire King? An Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Life?” Lin Yuan immediately recognized the other based on the features of the Flame Giant.

The Turbid Fire King, a skinny old man who during the first opening of the heaven’s gate, had teamed up with four other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Strength individuals, attempting to besiege the Four Divine Kings.

In the two-dimensional world, the Turbid Fire King had a thin build but in the main universe, he was a unique life form, only slightly inferior to the Four Divine Kings and Mother of the Tree Realm; otherwise, he wouldn’t have tried to besiege the Divine Kings.

“It’s too incredible…” Lin Yuan felt every aspect of the Flame Giant’s body vividly—the minutiae of its physical structure, the numerous innate abilities it possessed… Even the profound laws involved in the Flame Giant’s mere breath captivated Lin Yuan.

“Is this what makes a unique life form unparalleled?”

Lin Yuan withdrew his mind from the orb, his eyes filled with awe.

Compared to humans, unique life forms were too powerful, especially the unparalleled ones like the Flame Giant, born at Sixth Rank, who could grow to Ninth or Tenth Rank by merely taking a nap, reaching Eleventh Rank effortlessly.

Among the Starry Sky Races, even those with peak lineage like the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun were only Sixth Rank as adults. To advance to Seventh and Eighth Rank, they had to rely on their own efforts.

The majority of Starry Sky Wanderer Kun couldn’t reach Eighth Rank.

But a unique life form, unparalleled and singular? They were the ‘favored children’ of the universe, naturally achieving peak levels of life without investing much effort.

Of course, it is precisely this ‘smooth sailing’ that makes the chances of unique life forms reaching ultimacy very slim. To become a Supreme Being, reliance on innate talent is insufficient.

In the current universe, the majority of the ultimate beings were those who grew from weak life forms.

“Continue.”

After some thought, Lin Yuan sent a portion of his mind into another orb.

Thunder rolled.

This time, Lin Yuan transformed into a member of the Silver-armored Gold-horned Alien Race, engaged in battle with a mighty life form.

Thunder rolled.

Space continuously collapsed.

The various rule insights revealed by the Silver-armored Gold-horned Alien Race during the battle all surged into Lin Yuan’s mind.

“Material rules, this Silver-armored Gold-horned Alien has high mastery of the Great Destruction Rule,” Lin Yuan thought to himself, “And his physical body, while not on par with the Turbid Fire King, is also extremely extraordinary in some aspects.”

Lin Yuan deeply explored the insights. The four luminous orbs given by the half-meter-high elder hadn’t been specifically ‘refined’ and ‘purified.’

They could not bring the direct understanding as probing the orb with the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule had done.

But for Lin Yuan, there was no difference; with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, countless flashes of spiritual light emerged in his mind.

“The Tenth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, I now have a direction…”
